$description: SHA-256 hashes of inline <script> blocks the current site build emits. `revkit check-dist` fails when a built page carries an inline script whose hash is NOT in this list. Regenerate after a Starlight or Astro upgrade by running `bun packages/cli/bin/revkit.js check-dist --print-hashes site/dist` and commit the diff — a hash change is a signal the vendored script content moved, and the reviewer should look at the diff before accepting it.
$comment: Each entry names the vendor / feature the script comes from so a maintainer can tell at a glance which pipeline emitted it.
